title: Glasshouse — institutional accountability evidence dataset (say vs. do)
description:
A public-interest dataset recording the gap between what major financial institutions publicly commit to (archived proxy-voting / stewardship policies) and what they actually do (SEC N-PX proxy votes, 13-F / N-PORT holdings), alongside the enforcement record. Built for researchers, journalists, and advocacy organizations to consume, verify, and cite.

This version covers 14 systemic asset managers with full say+do coverage (~91% of tracked voting AUM): BlackRock, Vanguard, State Street, Fidelity, J.P. Morgan Asset Management, Goldman Sachs Asset Management, BNY, Invesco, UBS Asset Management, T. Rowe Price, Franklin Templeton, DWS, Northern Trust, and BNP Paribas Asset Management. ~3.36M de-duplicated proxy votes span the 2023-2025 meeting years (with earlier years for some filers).

Every record carries a source URL and retrieval date; votes are de-duplicated (filter is_duplicate = 0); enforcement rows carry a resolution_type from a closed legal enum (a deferred-prosecution agreement is not a conviction; a docket is an allegation, not a finding). Coverage is partial by design and stated honestly in DATASHEET.md / COVERAGE.json. The bundle is independently verifiable via MANIFEST.sha256.
notes: Code: MIT. Data: CC-BY-4.0. Before publishing, set creators.name (Family, Given), add "orcid" and "affiliation" if available, and confirm the version label matches the release directory (release/v<DATE>).
